questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The cheapest cities to visit in Europe this summer
Why cruise holidays are becoming popular with young people
The most visited cities in the world and why people go there
How some cities are limiting tourists to protect themselves
questions.why: Rob says they'll discuss how some cities are putting restrictions on tourists.

questions.q: Why are more people travelling, according to Rob?
options: They have more free time and travel is cheaper
Cities are advertising more on social media
Work trips abroad are much more common now
Cruise ships are faster and more comfortable
questions.why: He says many have more leisure time and travelling has become relatively cheaper.

options: Hotels in city centres are far too expensive
Crowds can spoil the places people came to see
Tourists get lost easily in the narrow streets
Local food is disappearing from the restaurants
questions.why: She says crowding can spoil the atmosphere and beauty people came to see.

questions.q: According to Sabina Castelfranco, what don't Romans like tourists doing?
options: Taking too many photos inside museums
Eating pizza while walking in the street
Walking in fountains and going bare-chested
Speaking loudly and singing inside churches
questions.why: She says Romans don't like tourists bare-chested or wading in their fountains.

questions.q: What is another rule introduced in Rome?
options: Big fines for dropping litter and attaching love padlocks
A strict limit on the number of new hotel rooms in the city
A complete ban on large cruise ships near the coast
A daily tourist tax for everyone staying in the centre
questions.why: Sam mentions severe fines for litter and 'love padlocks' on monuments.

questions.q: What is Rob's opinion of Rome's new rules?
options: They are much too strict and will annoy visitors
They will stop tourists visiting the city at all
They are unfair to men who want to go shirtless
They are a good idea if they make the city nicer
questions.why: He says if it makes the city nicer for everyone, it's a good idea.

questions.q: What is Bruges going to do, according to Helen Coffey?
options: Build a Disney theme park
Limit how many cruise ships can dock
Close its narrow streets
Stop people staying overnight
questions.why: She says they're going to cap the number of cruises that can dock.

questions.q: Why don't cities like cruise visitors?
options: They are noisy
They damage monuments
They don't spend much money
They stay too long
questions.why: Helen says cruise visitors don't spend money, and Sam adds they don't stay overnight.
